The dentist and assistant were incredibly kind and helpful. They gave great advice and offered wonderful encouragement during the tooth extraction, which made me feel completely less scared. The extraction was painless; the anesthetic was excellent and worked very quickly. The dentist was very quick, probably because it wasn't a difficult case. The whole process took less than half an hour. I used my social security insurance, so I only paid a small additional fee. Great price, great quality. I highly recommend it! ⭐️🫶🏻 10/10!
